title: nlist.set

arguments.description: nested list name to bind to

body:
[nlist.set] sets an element of a nested list. The element can be an atom, a list or a nested list. You need to set the index with the 'set' message or argument (default 0) and it can be a float or a list depending on the level. The indexed element must exist.

You can replace a list with a single item, or a nested list with a list or an atom, which removes the further indexes of that list. Conversely, you can put a list or a nested list in the place of an atom and create a list of nested indexes.
